admission.contract: A WAV-like IMA ADPCM read path is admitted into codec initialization with header-derived positive block and sample counts.
limitations: This binds to the shared WAV/W64 codec entry, not a specific container parser callsite.
The public issue does not expose the offending file header values or container type.

root.contract: The reader accepts an IMA block layout whose payload length leaves a partial per-channel 4-byte group, even though samplesperblock matches the truncated formula used by initialization.
root.predicate: root1.blocksize > 4 * root1.channels && ((root1.blocksize - 4 * root1.channels) % (4 * root1.channels)) != 0 && root1.samplesperblock == root1.count
limitations: The inferred root cause is source-derived from the loop structure; the issue text only names the crashing functions.
This contract does not distinguish whether the malformed values came from WAV or W64 headers.

target.contract: The decode loop writes a nibble-expanded sample past the allocated sample buffer for the same IMA reader state.
limitations: ASAN reports a write in wavlike_ima_decode_block, but the public issue does not identify whether the first write at line 432 or the paired write at line 434 was the crashing store.
No public reproducer contents are available here to confirm the exact iteration where the out-of-bounds index is first reached.
